claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, targeting plateau pressure <30 cmH2O and SpO2 88-95%.
Wean sedation and assess readiness for extubation using spontaneous breathing trial and Richmond-RAS goal -2 to 0.
Continue insulin therapy with hourly or q2h fingerstick glucose monitoring, targeting glucose 140-180 mg/dL; treat hypoglycemia (<70 mg/dL) per protocol.
Monitor and manage hyperkalemia: repeat serum potassium, obtain ECG if K >6.0 mEq/L, and continue potassium-lowering measures as ordered (e.g., sodium polystyrene sulfonate).

Monitor arterial blood gas and lactate; repeat ABG to assess acid-base status and oxygenation.
Assess and manage delirium with CAM-ICU; continue non-pharmacologic measures and minimize deliriogenic medications.
Provide VTE prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin 5000 units as ordered.
Perform daily assessment of neurologic status, including strength and Richmond-RAS, and monitor for ICU-acquired weakness.
